description: iCloud Mail (IMAP/SMTP) + iCloud Calendar (CalDAV) connector. Indexes iCloud Mail as `apple:email` items — message HEADERS (subject, from, to/cc, date, message-id), a short capped plain-text body PREVIEW (~2 KB / 2000 chars), and attachment METADATA only (filename, size, mimetype). Indexes iCloud Calendar as `apple:event` items — summary, start/end, location, organizer, status, recurrence, attendee emails, and a ≤2000-char notes preview. It NEVER downloads attachment bytes, never fetches full message bodies, and never returns full event descriptions beyond the capped preview. Read tools: `apple_list`, `apple_get`, `apple_search` (mail) and `apple_calendar_list` (calendar). Four HITL-gated write tools: `apple_mail_send` (SMTP), `apple_mail_draft_create` (IMAP APPEND to Drafts), `apple_calendar_event_create` (CalDAV PUT), `apple_calendar_event_delete` (CalDAV DELETE). Credentials are a single Apple ID email + app-specific password authenticating IMAP (imap.mail.me.com:993 TLS), SMTP (smtp.mail.me.com:587 STARTTLS), and CalDAV (caldav.icloud.com). The sender From address is always pinned to the authenticated icloud_email (callers cannot override it). Credentials arrive as scoped environment variables injected at spawn time (APPLE_ICLOUD_EMAIL, APPLE_ICLOUD_APP_PASSWORD) — the connector never reads the vault.
